pins.name: TIP
pins.description: tip: left channel (stereo) or the signal (mono)

pins.name: TIP_SW
pins.description: tip switch: touches TIP while no plug is in, opens when a plug enters (plug detect, or a speaker cut-off)

pins.name: RING_SW
pins.description: ring switch: touches RING while no plug is in

notes: Put it at the board edge with the plug side (+Y) facing out: the housing's front at y = 0 on the edge line, the bushing (3.3 mm) overhanging it.

Plug detect: TIP_SW to a GPIO with a pull-up and TIP driven or grounded through the source; or simply leave TIP_SW and RING_SW unconnected (SJ1-3523N has no switches: the same footprint without pins 10 and 11).
Headphones from a DAC or amplifier: TIP left, RING right, SLEEVE ground; a mono signal: TIP and SLEEVE.
The five 1.2 mm holes take the housing's plastic pegs: non-plated.
